[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]In Bob capture, a `#` typed right after a top-level bullet's `- ` [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]opens a drawer menu that expands to the drawer's ALL-CAPS title, [/#D7D7AF]

[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]bullet as its own note, with drawer bullets merging into that [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]task's drawers. Completion, `capture-parse`, preview, and commit [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]always agree.[/#D7D7AF]

[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Drawer bullets in the capture grammar[/bold #D7AFFF]                         [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]drawer-bullets[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]drawer-bullets: make a first-level bullet's leading `#` a drawer [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]shortcut instead of a type marker, recognize drawer bullets on new tasks[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and new project notes, render and merge them through the commit [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]resolver, report them in capture-parse, and bump the grammar to 4.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Several notes on one existing task[/bold #D7AFFF]                            [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]note-bullets[dim] · [dim][/dim]after drawer-bullets[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]note-bullets: let a note-less `@route+id` (or `@route+id#drawer`) item [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]file each first-level bullet as its own note, file drawer bullets into [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the target's drawers, and report notes and drawers in JSON and human [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]output.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Bullet drawer menu, docs, and memory records[/bold #D7AFFF]                  [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]bullet-menu[dim] · [dim][/dim]after note-bullets[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]bullet-menu: open the drawer completion menu at a first-level bullet's [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`#`, replace with the bare ALL-CAPS title (plus the optional [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]nested-bullet continuation), finish the docs, and write the accepted [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]memory records.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Bob Mac Capture presentation[/bold #D7AFFF]                                  [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]mac-capture[dim] · [dim][/dim]after note-bullets, bullet-menu[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]mac-capture: paint drawer-bullet spans, summarize multi-note sub-bullet [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]previews from the new `notes`/`drawers` fields, and prove the bullet [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]drawer menu end to end with real-bob fixtures.[/#D7D7AF]
